name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd
title: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd - 524000 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Credit cost fell to 2.19% from 2.40% and GNPA to 1.20% from 1.37%, but no capital-cycle or supply signal; growth is retail-led with AUM up 10.4% QoQ and management pitching margin expansion over ~2 years.

capex.quote: we are investing in 300 -400 branches every year

triggers.label: Portfolio yield up 45 bps QoQ
triggers.quote: our portfolio yield has increased by approximately 45 basis points over Q1FY27. So, it's now at 14.08%
triggers.highlight: portfolio yield has increased by approximately 45 basis points

triggers.label: AUM up 10.4% QoQ to ₹74,008 crore
triggers.quote: reporting a strong growth of 10.4% quarter-on-quarter, driven by continued momentum in retail products

guidance.quote: This quarter movement sits within the 10 to 25 basis point range we had guided for.
We remain on track to add a total of approximately 200 new branches in this financial year.
